title: Why BST shape depends on insertion order

ops.caption: Inserting in sorted order degenerates into a right-only chain
Searching for 70 requires traversing down the entire chain

ops.note: A balanced insertion order like [40, 20, 60, 10, 30, 50, 70] would create a tree where every search is O(log n)

ops.caption: In-order traversal outputs all values sorted, regardless of tree shape
